Wear it. Send it.

settings.intro: The same studio process you already know — just scheduled, tracked, and covered by your membership.
settings.cta_label: See what we do in the Spa

settings.heading: Join
settings.body: Choose your membership. Your included services are available from day one of your membership year.

settings.heading: Add your wigs
settings.body: Register each unit — brand, length, texture, cap. Every service is recorded against the wig it was done to.

settings.heading: Send it in
settings.body: Tell us what it needs, send photos, and ship it to the studio. We confirm the moment it arrives.

settings.heading: We inspect first
settings.body: Nothing happens without your approval. If a unit needs work beyond what you asked for, we show you the price before we begin.

settings.heading: Restored and returned
settings.body: Serviced, quality-checked, and shipped home with tracking — and added to your unit's service history.

settings.heading: A record for every unit
settings.body: What was done, when, and by whom. No more guessing how long ago a unit was last serviced.

settings.heading: Nothing without approval
settings.body: We document every unit on arrival and quote any additional work before we touch it.

settings.heading: First in the queue
settings.body: Member units are scheduled ahead of one-off bookings, especially in the busy weeks.

settings.title: Before you join.
settings.intro: The details worth knowing up front.

settings.question: What if I don't send a wig every month?
settings.answer: You aren't expected to. Membership includes a set number of services per membership year, not per month — use them whenever your units need them.

settings.question: Do unused services roll over?
settings.answer: Rollover terms are being finalised and will be stated here before membership opens.

settings.question: Can I send in wigs that aren't from The T Collection?
settings.answer: Yes. Outside units are welcome, though some services are priced differently because their construction and history are unknown to us.

settings.question: Who pays for shipping?
settings.answer: Full mail-in shipping terms — including packaging, tracking, insurance and declared value — are set out in the Wig Spa service terms.

settings.question: What happens if my unit needs more work than I asked for?
settings.answer: We stop and tell you. You'll see the recommendation and the price, and nothing proceeds until you approve it. You can always ask for the unit back instead.

settings.question: Can I cancel?
settings.answer: Yes, from your account. Any minimum term will be stated clearly at checkout before you join.

settings.title: Book a single visit.
settings.sub: Membership isn't the only way in. Send us a unit for a one-off service and see how we work first.
settings.fineprint: Most services turn around in 5-7 business days.
